#!/bin/bash
set -eu
tmux -D -f /dev/null &
for i in {1..100}; do test -S "$TMUX_TMPDIR/tmux-$(id -u)/default" && break; sleep .1; done
tmux set-option -g default-shell /bin/bash
tmux new-session -d -s taurhaus -x 140 -y 48 /bin/bash
/tmp/th-l5-z4ddbnmd/home/.local/bin/taurhaus-daemon --port 30814 --data-dir /tmp/th-l5-z4ddbnmd/data &
wait $!
while true; do sleep 1; done

agents.name: alpha
agents.instructions: Reply briefly. Follow the project AGENTS.md. Never modify files.

agents.name: beta
agents.instructions: Reply briefly. Follow the project AGENTS.md. Never modify files.
